manual_steps: After technical readiness, use this worktree's normal development launch and a disposable/admin-controlled world, not an existing owner world. As a permission-2 operator with a live controlled body and a loaded, clear cabin-sized site, run /ms14 shuttle_fixture build and retain the returned ship ID.

Enter through the front airlock using normal movement/jumping. While aboard, run /ms14 shuttle_fixture cargo <ship-id>. One world jug containing five units of water should appear near the body, without overwriting either hand or the carrier inventory.

Aim at the jug and use the configured examine/pickup controls. Check coherent selection and oriented outlines; pick it up and drop it with Drop active hand (default Q). It should retain the five units and normal ownership. The outline is a physical-profile proxy, not the exact jug mesh.

Run /ms14 shuttle_fixture yaw <ship-id> 0.4 once. As the cabin turns, repeat selection, pickup and drop. New replacement drops should use the actor's current frame world basis without loss. This is an angular-velocity pulse, not a rotation angle or pilot control. Do not test high-speed impacts or pitch/roll; both remain outside this correction.
